subject: Sliding Puzzle
text: Pushing A and B together 55 times while sailing unlocks a sliding puzzle game.

evidence.quote: push A and B together 55 times to play a sliding puzzle game.

subject: Aldi Sea Port
text: Sailing due south of Coneria and then west into a port leads to a short walk from Elfland and the Castle of Elf.

evidence.quote: head due south of Coneria, and then west into a port. This lets you off a short walk's distance from Elfland and the Castle of Elf.

subject: Prince of the Elves
text: The Prince of the Elves is under a sleeping spell cast by Astos that can only be broken with an Herb.

evidence.quote: Here you'll find that the Prince of the Elves is under a sleeping spell cast on him by Astos, the dark elf. You'll also hear that only a Herb will wake him up.

subject: Matoya
text: Matoya possesses the herb required to awaken the sleeping elf prince.

evidence.quote: You'll also hear that Matoya has such an herb.

subject: Elfland Weapon and Armor Shops
text: Fighters can buy a Silver Sword, an Iron Shield, and a Wooden Helmet in Elfland.

evidence.quote: Buy Fighters a Silver sword, an Iron shield, and a Wooden helmet.

subject: Level 3 Magic
text: Level 3 magic spells available in Elfland include CUR2, FIR2, LIT2, HRM2, and AFIR.

evidence.quote: As far as spells go, CUR2, FIR2, and LIT2 are musts for level 3 magic. If you have a White Mage, buy HRM2 as well. AFIR is useful as well.

subject: Level 4 Magic
text: Level 4 magic spells available in Elfland include PURE, FAST, and ICE2.

evidence.quote: For level 4 magic, buy PURE, FAST, and ICE2 for sure, and then just buy whatever floats your boat, if you want to come up with the cash.

subject: King
text: A lone King inside the deserted Northwest Castle claims that Astos stole his crown.

evidence.quote: Enter and you'll find a deserted castle filled with bats, some more of those famous locked doors, and a lone King, who claims that Astos has stolen his crown.

subject: Marsh Cave North Path
text: Taking the north path at the entrance of the Marsh Cave leads to a room with treasure chests.

evidence.quote: When you first enter the Marsh Cave, you'll have the option to go north or south. The north path leads to a room with a few treasure chests, with nothing of value.

subject: Marsh Cave South Path
text: Taking the south path in the Marsh Cave leads down stairs to another room with stairs to the third basement.

evidence.quote: Head south, take the stairs to another room. Make your way to the little room at the bottom, where more stairs await.

subject: Wizards
text: In the third basement of the Marsh Cave, entering the room third from the top and second from the left triggers a fight with Wizards.

evidence.quote: Here in the third basement, you'll find a four by four arrangement of little rooms...go into the room third from the top, and second from the left. You'll have to fight a group of Wizards.

subject: Wizards
text: Wizards possess 84 hit points, are weak against LIT, and guard the crown.

evidence.quote: Wizards have 84 hit points, and a weakness for LIT (you did buy LIT2 before you came here, didn't you?). After defeating them take the crown and run.

subject: Astos
text: Speaking to the King in the Northwest Castle reveals he is Astos, initiating a battle.

evidence.quote: Talk to the King again and he will reveal that he is really Astos, the SOB that stole Matoya's crystal and casted the sleeping spell on the prince. You're gonna have to fight him.

subject: Astos
text: Astos has 168 HP, casts RUB, and yields Matoya's Crystal upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Astos has 168 HP and an attitude to boot. Keep nailing him with your strongest attacks and magic, healing if necessary (or if possible. This dude knows RUB!) When (or if) you win, you'll get Matoya's CRYSTAL.

subject: Matoya
text: Returning the Crystal to Matoya in her cave earns the Herb in exchange.

evidence.quote: Return to her cave, give her the CRYSTAL in exchange for the HERB.

subject: Mystic Key
text: Giving the Herb to the Prince in the Castle of Elves awakens him and rewards the party with the Mystic Key.

evidence.quote: Go back to the Castle of Elves, give the Prince the HERB. When he wakes up, he'll give your party the Mystic KEY, which will open up all those blasted locked doors.

subject: Locked Room
text: Unlocking the doors in Castle Coneria provides TNT.

evidence.quote: definitely unlock the doors in Castle Coneria, for some TNT.

subject: Coneria Port
text: Sailing west from the port of Coneria to the next port brings the party near the Dwarven Cave.

evidence.quote: head west from the port of Coneria, to the next port you find. This will put you a short way away from the Dwarven Cave.

subject: Dwarven Cave
text: Treasures found in the Dwarven Cave include an Iron Helmet and Silver Armor.

evidence.quote: The Iron Helmet is worth keeping if you've got a Fighter, but sell everything else. The Silver Armor is much more expensive than Iron, but it's also a lot weaker.

subject: Dwarven Cave
text: The Dragon Sword is found in the Dwarven Cave.

evidence.quote: The Dragon Sword might be good for thieves, but contrary to popular belief, FF1 weapons have no racial modifers.

subject: Nerrick
text: Delivering TNT to Nerrick in the Dwarven Cave allows him to complete the canal between the Aldi Sea and the Western Sea.

evidence.quote: You'll eventually find Nerrick, who is trying to make a canal between the Aldi Sea and the Western Sea. He's short on TNT at the moment, so if you're nice enough to lend him some (like you really have a choice), he can complete the job and you can move on.

subject: Canal
text: Sailing through the newly opened canal allows the ship to dock next to Melmond.

evidence.quote: Sail your ship through the newly formed canal, and dock up next to Melmond.

subject: Melmond Armor Shop
text: The armor shop in Melmond sells Steel Armor for 45000 GP.

evidence.quote: The armor shop has Steel Armor, one of the best in the game for Fighters. However, it comes with a 45000 GP price tag.

subject: Undead
text: Walking in front of the three treasure chests behind the locked door in the Northwest Castle triggers attacks by Undead creatures.

evidence.quote: The Locked Door of the Northwest Castle is one such place. The three treasure chests contain nothing of use (sell them!), but walking in front of them always triggers an attack by Undead creatures.

subject: Melmond Shops
text: Silver Bracelets and Iron Gauntlets can be purchased in Melmond.

evidence.quote: After getting some money, buy Silver Bracelets for your black or white mages, if any, and some Iron Gauntlets for fighters.

subject: Level 5 Magic
text: Spells discussed for acquisition in Melmond include CUR3, FIR3, LIFE, HRM3, and WARP.

evidence.quote: Namely let's talk CUR3, FIR3. If you have a White Mage, do get LIFE and HRM3 as well. If you have a Red or Black Mage, leave a spot for WARP.

subject: Melmond
text: Heading south past the rotting earth from Melmond leads to the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote: leave Melmond and head south past the rotting earth to the Earth Cave.

subject: Hall of Giants
text: The western hall of Basement 1 in the Earth Cave is known as The Hall of Giants and contains Giants and Iguanas.

evidence.quote: Basement 1: Be warned of the western hall when you enter the cave. Known as "The Hall of Giants", It contains nothing but Giants and Iguanas.

subject: Earth Elemental
text: Stepping in front of most chests in the treasure rooms of Basement 1 triggers a fight with an Earth elemental, which is weak against FIRE.

evidence.quote: enter any of the three treasure rooms and step in front of a chest. Most of the chests have an automatic fight with an Earth elemental, which has a weakness against FIRE

subject: Basement 1 Stairs
text: Heading east from the stairs in Basement 1 descends to Basement 2, where navigating right and down leads through the floor.

evidence.quote: So, head east from the stairs, and descend a level....Basement 2: This basement is made of several connecting chambers. Generally head to the right and down, and you should make your way through.

subject: Vampire
text: Heading clockwise through Basement 3 leads to the Vampire, who has 156 HP, is weak to FIRE and HARM, and yields the Ruby.

evidence.quote: Basement 3: This basement is pretty simple, too. Just try to head clockwise through the level until you meet the Vampire....The Vampire is pretty easy. He has 156 HP, and weaknesses against FIRE and HARM....You'll win a RUBY for your troubles.

subject: Stone Plate
text: Exploration beyond the Vampire in the Earth Cave is halted by a stone plate.

evidence.quote: You can try to continue, if you like, but you'll soon be stopped by a stone plate.

subject: Titan
text: Entering the Titan's Tunnel to the southwest and feeding the Ruby to the Titan allows the party to pass through.

evidence.quote: You'll enter the Titan's Tunnel. Feed the Titan the RUBY, and he'll let you pass through.

subject: Titan's Tunnel
text: Treasure chests in the Titan's Tunnel contain a Great Axe and a Silver Helmet.

evidence.quote: The treasure chests in the cave contain a Great Axe and a Silver Helmet for your fighter.

subject: Sarda
text: In Sarda's Cave south of the Titan's Tunnel exit, Sarda gives the party the Rod to use on the stone plate.

evidence.quote: At the other exit of the Tunnel, head south to Sarda's Cave. He'll give you the ROD and tell you to use it on the stone plate to find the source of the earth's rot.

subject: Stone Plate
text: Using the Rod on the stone plate in the Earth Cave allows the party to continue downward.

evidence.quote: Head back to the stone plate, use the ROD, and continue downward.

subject: Basement 4
text: Basement 4 of the Earth Cave contains stone-inflicting Cockatrices and a Silver Shield.

evidence.quote: Basement 4: The Fourth basement has the same interconnecting chambers of the past two levels. Be careful of the Cockatrices here; they have a habit getting your characters stoned. Just keep heading left. Also there's a Silver Shield to be found here.

subject: Lich
text: Talking to the orb in Basement 5 triggers a battle with Lich, who has 400 HP and is weak against FIRE and HARM.

evidence.quote: enter the room and talk to the orb. It will shatter, leaving you to do battle with Lich, the Fiend of the Earth....Here are his vitals: 400 HP, weak against FIRE, and HARM type spells do a good bit of damage as well.

subject: Throne
text: Stepping onto the throne behind Lich warps the party out of the Earth Cave and restores light to one of the Orbs.

evidence.quote: If you defeat Lich, step foward onto the throne, which will automatically warp you out of the cave. Check out your subscreen when you leave: one of your ORBS will have regained it's light.

subject: Crescent Lake Equipment Shops
text: Sailing east past Elfland leads to Crescent Lake, where shops sell Silver equipment including the Silver Axe and Silver Armor.

evidence.quote: Follow the shore to a dock to the northeast of Crescent Lake (noted chiefly for its proximity to a crecent-shaped lake). In this town, you'll find some Silver equipment, buy some, but avoid that Silver Armor like the rot of the earth. The Silver Axe is good for your fighter.

subject: Level 6 Magic
text: Magic spells sold in Crescent Lake include SOFT, INV2, EXIT, and LIT3.

evidence.quote: Buy SOFT if you have a white mage. Buy INV2 now if you have a white mage, later if you have a Red mage...Leave a slot for EXIT, be your white magic user White or Red...For a black mage get LIT3

subject: Circle of Sages
text: Speaking to the Circle of Sages in Crescent Lake rewards the party with the Canoe, enabling travel along rivers.

evidence.quote: explore the city until you find the Circle of Sages. Talk to each one of them. One of them will give you a CANOE, which will allow you to row your way through rivers.

subject: River
text: Traveling along the river by canoe leads to the Gurgu Volcano.

evidence.quote: crank up your CANOE and explore the river. Watch out for the river monsters. Eventually you'll find yourself at the Gurgu Volcano.

subject: Lava
text: Walking across lava in Basement 1 of the Gurgu Volcano damages the party with every step.

evidence.quote: Basement 1: The first basement of the volcano is not difficult to navigate. Just beware that the lava does damage to you at every step, but you can't avoid it.

subject: Basement 2 Treasure Room
text: The treasure room in Basement 2 of the Gurgu Volcano contains 3 Silver Helmets, a Silver Shield, a Silver Axe, potions, and gold.

evidence.quote: Basement 2: The second basement is really easy: just head straight to the left. You can explore the treasure room if you wish, 3 Silver Helmets, a silver shield, a silver axe, some potions, and a bit of gold will be your reward.

subject: Fire Elementals
text: Fire elementals guard most of the treasure chests in Basement 2 of the Gurgu Volcano.

evidence.quote: Just watch out for the Fire elementals that guard most of the treasure.

subject: Basement 3A Stairs
text: In Basement 3A of the Gurgu Volcano, heading right until reaching the end leads to stairs.

evidence.quote: Basement 3A: This level is easy too. Head Right until you can't no more, then take the stairs.

subject: Basement 4A Stairs
text: Basement 4A of the Gurgu Volcano is filled with lava and contains stairs leading up to Basement 3B.

evidence.quote: Basement 4A: This floor presents no mazes, just completely filled with lava. The stairs will take you up to Basement 3B.

subject: Basement 3B Path
text: Navigating Basement 3B in the Gurgu Volcano requires walking down, taking the first left, heading down again, and moving all the way left.

evidence.quote: Basement 3B: Walk down, take the first left, then down again, then all the way left.

subject: Northwest Treasure Room
text: The northwest treasure room of Basement 4B contains the Ice Sword and a Flame Shield.

evidence.quote: Basement 4B: This level is filled with treasure rooms. The one in the northwest corner contains the Ice Sword, which should be equipped on your Fighter (or Red Mage, if you wish). It also has a Flame Shield, which is good against Ice attacks

subject: West Branch
text: In Basement 5 of the Gurgu Volcano, the west branch of the 8 branches leads to the Flame Armor.

evidence.quote: Basement 5: This room is simple. It has 8 branches. The west branch leads to the Flame Armor (good against Ice attacks), and the southwest branch leads to Kary, the fiend of Fire.

subject: Kary
text: The southwest branch of Basement 5 leads to Kary, who has 600 HP and is resistant to all elements.

evidence.quote: Kary has 600 HP, and is resistant to all Elementals.

subject: Throne
text: Stepping onto the throne after defeating Kary exits the Gurgu Volcano and lights another Orb.

evidence.quote: After victory, step on the throne to exit the Volcano. You'll see that yet another ORB has lighted.
